description.value: Tofino Coffee Roasting Company is a locally-owned café and roastery in the heart of Tofino, roasting specialty coffee on a Loring S15 and sourcing beans directly from ethically aligned farms and importers. The café serves carefully brewed single-origin offerings and freshly baked pastries in a cozy, welcoming space popular with Tofino locals. Cyclists passing through town can pick up a signature espresso blend or purchase roasted beans to take on the road.

address.value: 605 Gibson St, Suite 112, Tofino, BC V0R 2Z0
